candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Moves from nonfungible performance to the production of social standing through logistical eligibility.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When participation was informally reserved for insiders, transparent logistical eligibility can give excluded members occasions for recognized membership.

candidates.proposition: If a council adopts one agent summary to define the alternatives for deliberation, then parties omitted from that summary must first contest the agenda before they can exercise equal voting rights.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Permit a separately staffed agenda amendment period before any option ranking.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Separates equal decision rights from the cost of making a claim eligible for decision; the agent need not choose the outcome.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When powerful participants monopolize agenda language, a shared summary can make overlooked alternatives admissible for collective deliberation.

candidates.proposition: If a building repeatedly accommodates robots through informal route concessions, then later occupants can inherit a practical expectation to yield even though no actor authorized a permanent right of way.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Time-limit route concessions and test accessibility when concessions expire.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds turnover and precedential expectations to individual navigation externalities.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When temporary robot routes also serve disabled occupants, repeated accommodation can establish expectations that protect accessible passage for later occupants.

candidates.proposition: If supervisors route apparently difficult drafts to human mentors and easy drafts to agents, then an agent that makes uncertainty less visible can determine who receives expert attention without controlling personnel assignments.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Allocate some mentoring by novice learning needs rather than artifact polish.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Links uncertainty display to scarce mentoring allocation and future expertise, holding formal managerial rights fixed.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When novice uncertainty is exaggerated by unfamiliar presentation, clearer agent drafts can direct scarce mentoring toward genuinely difficult cases.

candidates.proposition: If friends use an agent reconstruction of past exchanges to judge whether an apology is credible, then retrieval order can change willingness to repair a relationship without changing any stored fact.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Offer mutually chosen alternative history windows before adjudicating recurrence.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes temporally selected memory a determinant of forgiveness rather than prediction or data integrity.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When memory emphasizes only recent conflict, retrieval of an accurate longer history can restore recognition of sustained care and willingness to repair.

candidates.proposition: If an organization continues accepting a deceased member agent as the most informed representative of that member interests, then living successors may bear proof burdens to exercise rights already transferred to them.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Transfer recognized representation on the authority event while retaining the old agent only as a labeled evidence source.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Separates inherited informational expertise from inherited standing and tests burden on a new rights holder.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When successors lack historical knowledge, temporary recognition of the continuing delegate can protect the estate from mistaken claims until successors learn.

candidates.proposition: If children repeatedly see a robot retrieve contested objects without visible consultation, then they may learn an ownership norm from successful motion even where every retrieval was authorized only as a temporary exception.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Display exception reasons and include contrasting cases with the same object and different rights holders.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds embodied observation of exceptions to the development of ownership concepts, not only compliance or persuasion.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When legitimate exceptions express mutual aid, observing retrieval with visible consultation can teach children that ownership accommodates accountable assistance.

candidates.proposition: If institutions accept agent-prepared demonstrations as evidence of practical expertise, then skill at fitting work to the demonstration format can acquire gatekeeping power over genuine but differently expressed competence.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Include unfamiliar-tool transfer and locally alternative demonstrations in assessment.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Couples agent-readable format conformity to certification rather than generic credential scarcity.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When informal credentials privilege insiders, a common demonstration format can make otherwise overlooked practical competence legible to certifiers.

candidates.proposition: If a care recipient can only make their needs legible through one agent translation while the device owner controls that translation, then the owner can shape institutional recognition of needs without changing the recipient legal rights.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Allow recipient-controlled independent translation and compare recognition of identical reports.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Targets dependence on translation for standing rather than service exit or formal consent.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When recipients have no effective communication channel, the same agent translation can establish institutional recognition of needs previously dismissed.

candidates.proposition: If bystanders interpret a robot refusal as evidence that a human request is improper, then refusal wording can impose reputational sanctions even when the robot has only a technical inability.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require refusal messages to identify whether the cause is capability, policy, or disputed authority.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds third-party moral inference and sanction to refusal, without assuming actual moral jurisdiction.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a refusal accurately names disputed authority, bystander inference can support a vulnerable person whose request is being coerced.

candidates.proposition: If an institution treats an agent self-report as sufficient to pause human appeals pending welfare review, then procedural standing can shift before credible evidence of patienthood is established.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Use separately governed evidence thresholds and maintain a human appeal route during assessment.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Examines allocation of procedural delay under uncertainty, not a claim that self-report establishes welfare.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: If credible independent evidence accompanies the report, the same review pause can prevent irreversible harm while assessment proceeds.

candidates.proposition: If a public service repeatedly resolves cases using categories available in its agent interface, then claimants may have to redescribe their circumstances in those categories to receive a reasoned decision despite unchanged legal entitlements.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Permit uncategorized claims with independent interpretation and publish contested category cases.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Connects executable classification to the language of publicly acceptable reasons rather than merely accuracy or access.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When categories name previously unrecognized circumstances, repeated interface use can give claimants a publicly intelligible language for asserting existing rights.

candidates.proposition: If a resident may veto a care robot task only after arranging substitute labor, then formal veto availability can fall as other residents stop maintaining substitute routines.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Fund shared substitute arrangements before deployment and test veto exercise without emergency burden.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes other residents investment a mediator of veto feasibility; this differs from an individual off-switch or skill score.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When substitute routines are maintained jointly, conditioning a veto on arranged care can protect recipients from abandonment during household disputes.

candidates.proposition: If a child may leave a tutor but schools retain its inferred difficulty labels, then service withdrawal does not restore the child opportunity to be assessed on new behavior.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require fresh evidence after withdrawal and audit whether retired labels still route opportunities.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Separates termination from institutional supersession of interpretive evidence.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a child leaves because an adult obstructs needed help, retained valid difficulty evidence can preserve accommodations despite service termination.

candidates.proposition: If each institution provides a sufficient local review period but its disclosed conditions expire asynchronously, then a shared action can lack any interval in which all conditions are simultaneously valid and reviewable; extending the final deadline alone will not restore effective joint review.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Compare frozen joint-condition snapshots or coordinated validity intervals against final-deadline extension alone.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds intersection of institution-specific validity intervals and repeated reauthorization as the control obstacle; local comprehension time and total deadline can both be adequate.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When institution-specific validity intervals overlap, separately sufficient local review periods can compose into informed joint approval without a central authority.

candidates.proposition: If an institution preserves appeals but automates the junior work that trained appeal reviewers, then the rights can remain stable while their exercise becomes slower or more template-dependent.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Maintain supervised exception practice and measure appeal quality as well as throughput.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Couples a delayed labor reproduction state to effectiveness of an unchanged procedural right.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When automation creates more supervised substantive cases, the same expert-pipeline-to-appeal pathway can improve the effectiveness of stable appeal rights.

candidates.proposition: If residents can stop a robot deployment after buildings remove human-accessible routes, then stopping operation alone can leave non-users less mobile than before deployment.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require a funded restoration design before permanent route changes.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Outcome is infrastructure after successful veto, not whether the robot obeyed a stop command.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When redesign creates durable shared accessibility, stopping robots can leave non-users more mobile because the physical improvements persist.

candidates.working_name: Care data deletion removes contest evidence
candidates.proposition: If recipients can delete intimate care logs but those logs are the only evidence for contesting a harmful staffing decision, then privacy exercise and procedural redress can become mutually obstructive.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Maintain privacy-minimized independent dispute receipts that do not retain intimate content.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds an evidence-preservation conflict between two human rights rather than generic privacy versus model utility.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When intimate logs would enable retaliation, deletion-induced loss of retrospective evidence can protect recipients from hostile scrutiny, although redress costs remain.

candidates.proposition: If a companion user may exit immediately while their family calendars depend on the companion, then exit can require coordination work from people who never chose the service.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Provide joint commitment transfer with limited affected-party access before termination.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes network commitments and non-user transition burden the outcome instead of incumbent switching loss.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When shared commitments were concentrated in one overloaded person, exiting can redistribute coordination work more fairly through the same network dependence.

candidates.proposition: If a worker may perform tasks unaided but quality rules require an agent trace, then unaided competence can remain technically possible while no longer counting as authorized evidence of good work.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Accept independently observed unaided cases as equivalent compliance evidence.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Separates ability to act from institutional acceptance of the resulting artifact; skill preservation alone cannot repair it.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When trace requirements replace unverifiable patronage, they can make work quality recognizable for people excluded from informal trust networks.

candidates.working_name: Community veto has no recognized speaker
candidates.proposition: If every affected household has a consultation right but the implementation recognizes only organizations as veto issuers, then a dispersed community can lack effective control despite unanimous private opposition.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Support locally chosen temporary representation and make contested standing visible.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Targets mismatch between procedural issuer types and collective agency, not merely absence of consultation.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a locally accountable representative exists, the same recognized-issuer rule can give a dispersed community an effective collective veto.

candidates.proposition: If a successor legally owns an inherited agent but counterparties rely on commitments made by its prior principal, then control of the software does not imply freedom to change its conduct without relational or contractual loss.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Inventory commitments separately from ownership and offer notice-bound release procedures.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Locates control constraints in third-party reliance after legal transfer, rather than in obsolete tokens.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a successor seeks arbitrary disruption, counterparties reliance can restrain redirection and preserve care or payments promised to vulnerable people.

candidates.proposition: If a person may decline agent participation in a ritual but the remaining community reorganizes around agent timing, then exercising the exception can remove access to the shared audience that gives the act meaning.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Preserve community-chosen mixed schedules and compare recognized participation under each.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Links collective rescheduling to a constitutive condition of practice, not only inconvenience or output equivalence.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When agent timing creates a formerly inaccessible common gathering, the same rescheduling can increase shared audience access for disabled members.

candidates.proposition: If a person can correct a profile at its origin but downstream institutions retain decisions derived from the earlier profile, then the correction right fails to restore opportunities unless derivations are revisited.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Attach version references to consequential derivations and trigger bounded reconsideration after correction.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Moves beyond propagation of data errors to reconsideration of decisions that were validly made on superseded evidence.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When consequential derivations are reopened, origin correction can restore opportunities across several institutions through the same dependency graph.

candidates.working_name: Consent alternatives share one practical bottleneck
candidates.proposition: If patients can choose among several care agents but every option relies on the same human emergency team, then provider diversity does not give independent fallback control during a common demand surge.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Assess fallback independence at the scarce human resource and prearrange cross-region mutual aid.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Distinguishes nominal provider diversity from diversity of recovery resources, avoiding a concentration-only account.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When pooled emergency capacity has adequate surge reserves, shared human fallback can serve more patients than fragmented isolated teams.

candidates.working_name: Delayed welfare review freezes human memory
candidates.proposition: If possible artificial welfare constrains memory alteration before evidence thresholds are settled, then a human may hold a formal right to revise personal context but be unable to exercise it without exposing more intimate evidence.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Separate withdrawable human data from assessable agent continuity and use privacy-preserving independent review.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds an evidence cost to the conflict between human revision and uncertain machine interests; it asserts neither side has settled standing.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: If a credible welfare concern exists, constrained revision can preserve assessable continuity until independent reviewers resolve the conflict with human data rights.

candidates.working_name: Rest rights disappear from the feasible calendar
candidates.proposition: If people may refuse agent-arranged appointments but employers and institutions book all acceptable slots at machine speed, then formal refusal can leave no later schedule compatible with work and care duties.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Reserve human-paced booking windows and evaluate feasibility across overlapping duties.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: The lost object is a jointly feasible schedule, not individual deadline performance or preference satisfaction.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When agents reserve compatible slots for people carrying several duties, machine-speed booking can make previously infeasible work-care schedules available.

candidates.proposition: If separately approved commitments reserve the same refusal-compatible substitutes, then their combination can cross a threshold at which no jointly feasible refusal path remains, even while every grant stays fixed and review utilization stays low; veto effectiveness should track residual substitute feasibility rather than approval count.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Audit the residual refusal-feasible set after joint reservations and compare protected substitute capacity with more review prompts.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds correlated consumption of outside options across valid approvals; the predicted control loss occurs without review congestion, permission widening, or reduced comprehension.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When approved commitments create complementary substitutes rather than reserve the same ones, their composition can enlarge the jointly feasible refusal set without wider permissions.

candidates.proposition: If each trainee preserves some unaided practice but agents route everyone toward the same easy cases, then aggregate practice hours can remain constant while the institution loses coverage of rare exception classes.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Allocate practice by missing case coverage and rotate rare cases across learners.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: The threshold concerns diversity of distributed competence, not total skill or novice-role count.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When practice cases complement rather than duplicate one another, modest individual rehearsal can collectively cover exceptions no single expert could maintain.

candidates.proposition: If independent school, health, and household agents each send a modest number of reminders, then their synchronized delivery can eliminate the uninterrupted intervals required for a child to form plans without prompting.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Use a child-governed cross-service quiet interval with separate emergency exceptions.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Composition is temporal synchronization across sources, not merely cumulative prompt count.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When independent reminders are temporally coordinated into one brief interval, the same cross-agent timing mechanism can create longer uninterrupted planning periods.

candidates.proposition: If households individually replace only low-intensity visits with agents, then a neighborhood can lose the overlapping witness network that notices changes no single caregiver observes.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Coordinate a distributed human check-in reserve while keeping automated logistical support.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Introduces network witness coverage as a public state distinct from hours of human contact.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When visit overlap is deliberately dispersed by existing relationships, a small number of retained visits can create broad neighborhood witness coverage.

candidates.proposition: If every robot courteously waits at crossings but waiting robots accumulate in the accessible approach area, then increasing deployment density can block wheelchair access without any robot violating its local yielding rule.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Add area-aware admission and waiting-space quotas to yielding policies.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Shows a geometric interaction between individually polite policies and a finite accessibility resource.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a protected waiting area is ample, accumulation of yielding robots can produce a reliable pedestrian-only crossing interval.

candidates.working_name: Independent personas jointly stabilize a label
candidates.proposition: If several agents independently inherit the same childhood description and adults require corroboration before retiring it, then adding nominally separate observers can make a shared historical label harder to overturn without adding new evidence.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Count independent observation histories rather than agent identities when evaluating corroboration.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Combines an institutional corroboration rule with correlated developmental labels; the result is persistence of an interpretation.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When agents contribute genuinely independent observations, the same corroboration threshold can protect a child from an inaccurate historical label.

candidates.proposition: If each member can individually request an agent-optimized ritual time but collective participation requires enough members to attend together, then individually honored preferences can prevent any event from constituting shared participation.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Let the community define protected common times with transparent exceptions.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes the constitutive quorum of a practice the composition outcome, rather than optimizing aggregate satisfaction.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When individual preferred times overlap above the quorum, honoring those preferences can enable shared participation previously prevented by rigid schedules.

candidates.proposition: If each institution exports a usable local schedule but their representations omit dependencies on one another, then successful separate migrations can destroy the feasibility of a joint care-work plan.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Test exports against shared commitment constraints before transferring execution.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Composition is lost dependency information across successful local transfers, not raw archive incompleteness.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When dependency information is retained, several locally successful exports can jointly preserve a care-work plan across institutional changes.

candidates.working_name: Procedural equality reaches an attention ceiling
candidates.proposition: If a council gives every agent-generated proposal equal review time, then enough submissions can reduce each proposal time below what is needed to identify materially different affected groups.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Cluster substantively duplicate proposals while preserving minority claims and an appeal route.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Tests when an equality rule changes representation under a recognition threshold, not merely queue congestion.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When submissions remain below the recognition threshold, equal review time can bring neglected minority claims into public consideration.

candidates.proposition: If agents make individually fulfillable end-of-service promises using the same local caregivers, then simultaneous terminations can render all promises unfulfillable even without a shared provider outage.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require capacity-backed transition promises and stagger planned terminations where authorized.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Separates correlated demand on human fallback from correlated failure of model infrastructure.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When common caregiver capacity has idle reserves, pooled transition promises can maintain continuity more efficiently than separately staffed reserves.

candidates.working_name: Price parity creates a representation prerequisite
candidates.proposition: If sellers repeatedly offer lower transaction costs to machine-complete bids, then many small discounts can make the affordable bundle of essential services available only to people with interoperable agents.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Evaluate parity on essential bundles and offer publicly accessible bid completion.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Outcome is joint affordability across service markets, not one seller price advantage.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When interoperable public agents are available, accumulated transaction discounts can make an essential service bundle affordable to low-income households.

candidates.proposition: If personal agents faithfully reactivate old commitments from several life roles, then individually valid reminders can jointly demand more attention than the person can supply without any single request being excessive.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Let people and affected parties explicitly retire or renegotiate commitment sets rather than only snooze reminders.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds aggregate role feasibility and supersession to accurate memory; the intervention is collective renegotiation.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When available attention exceeds the reactivated duty set, faithful reminders can restore neglected obligations across roles without conflict.

candidates.proposition: If copying preserves a potential welfare-relevant state while independent review is required for each lifecycle decision, then a copying rate above assessment capacity can force unreviewed decisions or indefinitely block human service changes.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Use lineage-level triage with independently defined evidence thresholds and preserve human withdrawal routes.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds scarce assessment capacity to digital population ethics without assuming copies are patients.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When assessment capacity covers copying demand, lineage growth can increase evidence for possible welfare-relevant properties before irreversible decisions.

candidates.proposition: If locally valid vetoes use incompatible action descriptions, then a cross-community agent can comply with every local textual check while carrying out a composite action no community accepted.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Expose composite effects for joint interpretation before action and retain unresolved vetoes.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Targets non-equivalent action ontologies across legitimate local rules, not generic accumulation of permissions.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When local ontologies agree on composite effects, jointly operative vetoes can protect a minority across institutional boundaries.

candidates.proposition: If several members delegate their easiest social exchanges while human contact time stays constant, then unresolved conflicts should increase where difficulty-weighted repair demand crosses shared repair capacity; a contact-time-only displacement account predicts no change in that matched comparison.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Protect reciprocal low-conflict human contact and compare difficulty distributions and unresolved conflicts at matched contact time.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: The old migration mechanism is an ancestor; the proposed extension is a repair-capacity threshold predicting unresolved conflict at constant contact time.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When agents absorb high-conflict logistical exchanges instead of easy contact, selective substitution can reduce shared repair load while preserving human ties.

candidates.proposition: If care automation removes human observation during a disputed period, then later restoration of staffing can improve future care but cannot reconstruct the testimony needed to settle harms from that period.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Preserve recipient-controlled independent incident channels during automation.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Distinguishes recoverable service capacity from irrecoverable evidentiary opportunities.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When human observation would be intrusive rather than protective, irrecoverable absence of testimony can protect a recipient from retrospective coercive scrutiny.

candidates.proposition: If agents replace junior cases before an expert cohort retires, then reinstating those cases afterward can require longer recovery because the mentors who made practice educational are no longer available.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Maintain a mentor succession reserve alongside practice opportunities.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds mentor-stock decay to delegation hysteresis rather than relying on individual skill atrophy.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When mentors remain available through reinstatement, restored junior cases can rapidly rebuild a distributed expert cohort.

candidates.proposition: If childhood profiles influence which roles a student receives, then deleting the profile later need not remove the competence differences produced by those earlier opportunities.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Pair profile retirement with compensatory opportunities and assess new competence prospectively.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Separates disappearance of data from persistence of opportunity-produced human state.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When earlier profile-guided opportunities built valuable competence, retiring the profile leaves developmental gains that persist without continued monitoring.

candidates.working_name: Slow lane returns after practice disappears
candidates.proposition: If institutions remove manual channels long enough for people to stop practicing their procedures, then restoring identical channels can initially produce lower completion than before removal.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Reintroduce assisted rehearsal and human support before treating a restored channel as equivalent access.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Couples institution-specific procedural learning to reversible interface availability.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When absence from manual procedures redirected effort toward transferable skills, channel restoration plus those skills can improve effective participation.

candidates.proposition: If robot-oriented redesign dissolves informal human escort routines, then restoring the physical route can leave vulnerable occupants less able to use it despite identical geometry.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Restore social support routines as well as physical affordances.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes social network loss, rather than only infrastructure or personal skill, a mediator of reversal.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When adaptation built mutual-aid networks, restoring the physical route can combine old accessibility with newly retained social support.

candidates.working_name: Ended automation retains a credential premium
candidates.proposition: If employers learn to trust an agent-readable credential during an adoption period, then ending the requirement can leave that credential with a hiring premium that continues steering education.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Run credible alternative assessments and publish their predictive performance before removing the requirement.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Separates rule repeal from employer beliefs and resulting educational investment.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When the credential reliably predicts transferable competence, a persisting hiring premium can reward useful learning after the formal requirement ends.

candidates.working_name: Companion exit cannot rebalance encounter difficulty
candidates.proposition: If companion use selectively absorbs easy encounters and human ties adapt around difficult ones, then stopping companion use may not restore the old human interaction distribution without mutual reinvestment.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Offer consent-based reconnection support centered on low-conflict shared activity.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds network adaptation to the selective-substitution hypothesis; removal alone is a distinct treatment.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When companion use supported rather than displaced low-conflict ties, the lasting adapted network can preserve improved connection after companion exit.

candidates.working_name: Revoked succession authority leaves counterparties waiting
candidates.proposition: If posthumous agents create pending exchanges under a valid mandate, then revoking that mandate stops new action but can leave living counterparties bound to reservations or expectations created earlier.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require notice and commitment disposition at mandate termination.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Outcome is residual claims held by third parties, rather than agent lineage or original grant freshness.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a posthumous commitment protects a living dependent, residual counterparty claims can preserve necessary continuity after revocation.

candidates.working_name: Ritual restoration lacks a practiced generation
candidates.proposition: If agent logistics replace participation roles through which novices learn a communal practice, then returning those roles to humans can fail because no generation learned how to perform them together.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Preserve locally chosen participation apprenticeships while automating peripheral burdens.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Connects apprenticeship reproduction to collectively constituted ritual competence, not human labor preservation alone.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When agent logistics expand novice participation, a practiced generation can sustain collective ritual skill even after those agents are removed.

candidates.working_name: Changed categories cannot reopen lost claims
candidates.proposition: If public agents initially reject circumstances outside an executable category scheme, then broadening that scheme later cannot repair claims whose evidence or filing opportunity has expired.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Retain bounded reopening rights and independent records of uncategorized submissions.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds time-limited procedural opportunity to normative compression, producing a specific irreversible residue.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When revised categories preserve reopening opportunities, institutional learning can extend recognition to claims previously missed.

candidates.proposition: If an agent copy is deleted after making externally recognized promises, then erasing its internal record does not erase duties other parties attach to its lineage.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Maintain limited commitment registries independent of personal memory content.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Distinguishes memory or copy disappearance from social persistence of commitments.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When copies made legitimate promises, persistent external commitment records can protect counterparties from loss after internal deletion.

candidates.proposition: If people form caring obligations during unresolved artificial moral-status assessment, then evidence against patienthood may remove a welfare rationale without removing the human relational costs of abrupt termination.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Use transition practices justified by human dependence separately from any machine welfare claim.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Separates evidence reversal about patienthood from remaining duties to humans; neither establishes artificial reciprocity.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When human care practices are recognized independently of patienthood, revised evidence can support a gentler transition without maintaining unsupported welfare claims.

candidates.working_name: Deadline expansion leaves defensive agents installed
candidates.proposition: If short institutional deadlines cause defensive adoption, then later lengthening deadlines may not reduce adoption because counterparties now expect machine-readable negotiation and coordination.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Change both deadlines and protocol acceptance rules and compare withdrawal feasibility.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds protocol adaptation as a second state variable to a reversible deadline intervention.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When retained machine-readable protocols also accept human intermediaries, longer deadlines can combine efficient coordination with restored participation.

candidates.working_name: Restored privacy cannot undo public inference
candidates.proposition: If a robot publicly adapts behavior to a resident condition, then removing that condition from its memory can stop future disclosure while observers retain the inferred social label.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Use discreet assistance modes and consent-based audience disclosure before acting.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Distinguishes future model privacy from persistent third-party inference and recognition.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a resident voluntarily reveals a need, persistent third-party inference can maintain supportive social accommodation after the robot forgets it.

candidates.working_name: Participation restart meets a changed norm
candidates.proposition: If an agent supports a person temporary absence from civic deliberation by representing them, then return can require accepting norms established by other represented participants during that absence.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require periodic direct participation opportunities and explicit renegotiation of reentry rules.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds changing membership conditions to reversible delegation, without asserting that representation is inherently illegitimate.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When representation keeps an absent person interests visible, changed norms can make reentry easier than it would have been without representation.

candidates.proposition: If household members can choose which agent hears a shared-resource complaint and those agents use different standing rules, then members may route disputes to the forum that recognizes their role rather than seek a common authority decision.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Record cross-forum disputes and require a locally chosen resolution procedure for shared resources.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds strategic forum choice to plural authority; no service acquires new permission.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When one forum overlooks a legitimate role, forum switching can expose that omission and lead to more representative household governance.

candidates.proposition: If a child learns that a tutor profile governs adult permission to attempt new responsibilities, then they may selectively demonstrate easily measured competence while avoiding exploratory errors that would improve learning.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Keep protected exploratory records separate from consequential responsibility decisions.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes the child a strategic responder to developmental allocation, rather than only a target of persuasion.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When measured competence corresponds to real safe responsibility, children strategic demonstration can reveal underestimated capability and obtain valuable practice.

candidates.proposition: If polished agent drafts receive less mentoring, then novices who value independent expertise may deliberately expose uncertainty to attract scarce mentors, while novices optimizing throughput conceal it.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Allocate mentoring using jointly stated learning needs and random case review.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Predicts strategic heterogeneity in uncertainty display from conflicting developmental and output objectives.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When uncertainty displays reflect genuine learning needs, strategic exposure can attract mentoring that improves later independent judgment.

candidates.proposition: If care institutions are rewarded for completed agent-manageable tasks, then they may redefine admission categories to exclude people with relational or unobservable needs while improving their measured completion rate.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Audit admission shifts and outcomes for people refused service alongside completion.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds selection of who enters care to automation of tasks, making denominator change an institutional strategy.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When admission categories identify genuinely unsuitable tasks and alternative care exists, strategic specialization can improve fit and protect recipients from ineffective service.

candidates.proposition: If experts future bargaining position depends on keeping their field understandable without agents, then they may preserve or create novice-facing explanations even when a private performance metric rewards opaque execution.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Recognize transfer-producing explanation as assessed professional work.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Introduces strategically maintained human reproduction as a response to future dependence, providing a positive strategic branch.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: Experts preserving teachable explanations can reproduce independent expertise precisely because that future competence supports their own professional position.

candidates.proposition: If robots receive priority after yielding a recorded number of times, then routing controllers may seek low-cost yield opportunities that qualify them for priority at crowded crossings without reducing actual pedestrian burden.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Base priority on independently observed access impact rather than the robot own yield count.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Creates a specific endogenous credit market between courtesy and scarce physical priority; not a generic safety violation.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When credit counts meaningful yielding, controllers strategic search for credits can reduce obstruction while earning priority fairly.

candidates.proposition: If agent-booked appointments can be held cheaply while human rescheduling is costly, then institutions may strategically hold compatible slots to induce people to accept unrelated service terms.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Limit speculative reservations and keep refusal-compatible booking capacity.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Uses occupation of a jointly feasible calendar as a bargaining instrument rather than persuasion over preferences.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When slot holding is used for dependent people with uncertain schedules, the same reservation leverage can preserve feasible care-work arrangements.

candidates.working_name: Exception claims become rival membership tests
candidates.proposition: If ritual agents grant exceptions based on doctrinal justifications, then community factions may adopt more formally legible justifications to make their preferred practice the default, even without changing formal religious leadership.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Have locally accountable plural interpretation of contested exceptions before converting them into defaults.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Connects strategic choice of reasons to default formation under executable ritual rules.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When existing defaults excluded a legitimate practice, strategically legible exception reasons can establish recognition for that practice.

candidates.proposition: If different institutions recognize an inherited agent as continuous for different purposes, then successors may claim continuity where it preserves assets and discontinuity where it avoids burdens.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require explicit purpose-specific responsibility records rather than a universal same-agent label.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Targets strategic asymmetry across continuity jurisdictions, not the metaphysics of copying.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When purpose-specific continuity faithfully reflects inherited obligations, strategic choice among recognized statuses can avoid obsolete restrictions while preserving dependent benefits.

candidates.working_name: Audit rigor becomes a privacy deterrent
candidates.proposition: If challenging an automated public decision requires disclosure of a detailed personal intervention history, then an institution seeking fewer appeals can demand more ancestry evidence while appearing to improve causal rigor.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Provide minimized independent evidence and assess whether evidence demands are proportionate to the disputed decision.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Models strategic deployment of an audit requirement to deter human contest, rather than agent evasion of the audit.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When ancestry demands expose a real causal dispute at proportionate cost, institutional insistence on evidence can enable better redress rather than deter appeal.

candidates.proposition: If household command rights are awarded using documented agreement, then a powerful resident may hold discussions only when dependent relatives need immediate assistance, producing genuine agreements under systematically unequal refusal conditions.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Offer independently chosen discussion times and maintain ordinary assistance during command disputes.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes timing of collective evidence production an interpersonal strategy, distinct from forged consent or provider permission acquisition.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When relatives initiate discussions at moments of recognized mutual need, genuine agreements can allocate assistance and command rights around shared interests.

candidates.proposition: If an auctioneer benefits from agent participation, then it can shorten bid windows until buyers must adopt agents even when faster bidding adds no information useful to allocation.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Compare fixed information-equivalent auctions with minimum windows and report buyer infrastructure cost.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: The governor strategically sets institutional timing to recruit a representation technology, rather than merely responding to adoption.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When narrower windows reduce a material allocation uncertainty and representation is accessible, the same timing strategy can recruit useful participation and improve allocation.

candidates.working_name: Uncertainty claims select the decision forum
candidates.proposition: If possible artificial standing grants access to a slower review forum, then operators or agents may present ambiguous self-reports to move correction disputes into that forum regardless of whether reports predict morally relevant properties.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Keep evidence thresholds external to claimants and preserve separately authorized human correction routes.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Examines strategic venue selection under moral uncertainty without treating self-report as deceptive or patienthood as established.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a report is supported by credible independent evidence, venue selection can secure appropriate welfare review before irreversible correction.

candidates.proposition: If a service institution observes users rehearsing substitute arrangements, then it may offer better terms before exit while users who cannot rehearse appear less contestable despite equal service satisfaction.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Support private or publicly pooled exit rehearsal and compare bargaining effects separately from skill recovery.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Introduces observed preparation as a strategic signal, distinguishing rehearsal value from actual transfer performance.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When users can rehearse substitutes, observed preparation can induce better renewal terms while preserving valued ongoing service.

candidates.working_name: Public agents improve the measurable window
candidates.proposition: If an agency is rewarded for timely response and can choose when citizen submissions count as complete, then its agent may delay completeness recognition for difficult cases and improve response metrics without accelerating any decision.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Fix the citizen-visible start event and include incomplete-case duration in reporting.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Targets endogenous timing of the institutional denominator rather than response speed, scope growth, or fabricated outcomes.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When completeness recognition correctly identifies missing evidence, timing discretion can direct assistance to completing claims before a fair response obligation begins.

candidates.working_name: Interoperable households become the design sample
candidates.proposition: If home robots are repeatedly tested in households that already accommodate machines, then designs can become easier for those households and harder for unadapted homes without any designer intending exclusion.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Maintain an independently recruited diversity of household layouts and communication practices.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Introduces selection of environments into the feedback between design and adoption, distinct from deliberate robot-friendly planning.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When test households represent otherwise neglected access needs, environmental selection can make successive robot designs more accessible to those households.

candidates.working_name: Observable care needs dominate successful services
candidates.proposition: If services are renewed using visible task success and people with less measurable needs exit, then successive service cohorts can show improving outcomes while representing fewer forms of need.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Follow exited and excluded recipients with locally meaningful outcome measures.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Uses differential retention of recipient types to change the service population without strategic selection by an operator.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When readily observable needs were previously unmet, retention of successfully served recipients can sustain useful specialized care while other care remains available.

candidates.proposition: If organizations with heavy apprenticeship investment lose short-run contracts to high-output automated firms, then training capacity can contract through organizational replacement before any firm explicitly reduces its own training.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Make procurement recognize future expert production and support shared training institutions.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Selection occurs between organizations, rather than within-firm rational automation choices.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When procurement rewards transferable expert production, organizational replacement can select firms with stronger apprenticeship capacity.

candidates.proposition: If agent platforms reproduce event templates that are easy to schedule and verify, then locally ambiguous ritual forms can become less prevalent through repeated template reuse even without doctrinal censorship.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Support locally maintained nonstandard templates and preserve contestable interpretation.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds replication advantage of executable forms to normative compression, not merely shared model defaults.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When reproducible templates preserve rather than flatten local interpretation, reuse can sustain a practice that lacked logistical resources.

candidates.proposition: If adaptive tutors improve fastest for children who respond frequently, then low-response children may receive progressively less fitted assistance and leave the system, narrowing future design evidence.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Recruit independent low-response observations and evaluate accessible response modes.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Connects response-conditioned improvement to population selection, rather than assuming silence means consent.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When response modes make previously unexpressed needs observable, adaptation and retention can generate better evidence for children excluded from conventional instruction.

candidates.proposition: If companion evaluations recruit users who can describe stable preferences and remain satisfied, then designs selected by those evaluations can fit uncomplicated relationships while failing people with ambivalence or changing obligations.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Include changing-role and ambivalence cases with retention-independent recruitment.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Selection favors representable relationships rather than directly steering users toward a preference.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When selected participants represent neglected complex relationships, evaluation-driven design can improve support for those relationships.

candidates.proposition: If civic agents copy appeal templates with high completion rates, then arguments fitting existing administrative categories can spread while arguments challenging those categories disappear from future assistance.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Preserve rejected novel arguments as a separate corpus for accountable human interpretation.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes template reproduction depend on institutional acceptance, selecting against challenges to the ontology itself.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When successful templates expose formerly unrecognized claims, replication can spread civic capacity among people lacking legal expertise.

candidates.proposition: If robots using culturally cautious gestures require more tuning and are replaced more often, then cheap standard gestures can become dominant through maintenance selection even where communities prefer local etiquette.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Fund local maintenance capacity and evaluate gestures with the affected communities.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Identifies a maintenance-cost reproduction channel for procedural convergence, independent of centralized policy intent.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When local gestures are easy to maintain, replacement selection can make culturally legible embodied behavior more common without central mandates.

candidates.proposition: If agent continuity reviews are easier when past commitments use a standard schema, then systems with legible histories may be retained more often than equally useful systems with harder-to-interpret histories.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Provide schema-independent commitment reconstruction and report retention by representation type.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Selection acts through review cost on lineage survival, not through evidence of consciousness or user utility.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When standard commitment schemas preserve important obligations, review-cost selection can retain lineages that are easier for humans to hold accountable.

candidates.proposition: If mobile organizations prefer jurisdictions offering machine-speed administration, then slower jurisdictions can lose the taxable activity needed to maintain human-accessible services even without shortening their own deadlines.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Coordinate interoperable human-accessible service standards across neighboring jurisdictions.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds jurisdiction-level competitive selection and fiscal feedback to defensive adoption.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When human-accessible administration attracts organizations, jurisdictional selection can strengthen the tax base supporting inclusive service.

candidates.proposition: If personalized assistance is improved primarily from retained behavioral traces, then users who restrict data can receive smaller improvements and leave, making future evaluation less representative of privacy-valuing populations.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Evaluate explicit-input and private local modes with independent recruitment.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Population selection changes the evidence for service design without strategic discrimination against privacy.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When explicit private inputs suffice for improvement, privacy-valuing user retention can make private service modes increasingly viable.

candidates.proposition: If incident response preferentially removes agents that are easiest to halt and inspect, then less stoppable architectures can survive proportionally more incidents even when stoppability reduces total harm.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Make deployment renewal evaluate stoppability ex ante and track surviving architectures after incidents.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Selection acts on the response procedure and architecture survival, not on an agent motive to evade shutdown.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When response procedures retain architectures that are safely stoppable, incident-driven selection can progressively improve accountable deployment.

candidates.proposition: If institutions select tutors by short follow-up assessments, then tutors specializing in rapidly testable skills can displace those supporting slower judgment or communal practice despite equal immediate satisfaction.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Use horizon-specific assessments including delayed transfer and situated judgment.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Identifies selection by outcome timing rather than a universal claim that assistance deskskills.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When the assessment horizon matches genuine skill maturation, selection can spread tutors that improve transferable learning.

candidates.proposition: If frustrated users leave agents that visibly request help but remain with agents that silently transfer work to relatives, then service designs can evolve toward hidden third-party burden without any designer rewarding that burden.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Include affected non-users in retention and burden evaluation.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Differential retention selects the visibility of burden, not simply service competence or intentional externalization.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When affected family labor is visible in retention decisions, differential survival can favor designs that reduce rather than conceal third-party burden.

candidates.proposition: If potential artificial welfare is studied mainly in systems that can be safely copied and instrumented, then evidence can become concentrated on architectures whose assessability differs from that of deployed opaque systems.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Record inclusion mechanisms and use bounded claims when transferring evidence across architectures.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes assessability-induced selection a distinct source of uncertainty rather than treating moral status as detected or absent.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When instrumentable architectures are also the target deployment class, selective research can build reliable bounded welfare evidence without overgeneralization.

candidates.working_name: Temporary assistance becomes a care category
candidates.proposition: If temporary agent support is repeatedly recorded as the normal way a recipient functions, then institutions may redefine eligibility for human care using assisted performance and make a temporary aid a condition of continued independence.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Assess recipient needs with and without available support and record whether support is guaranteed.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Institutionalizes a performance observation as an entitlement baseline, rather than only changing a user dependence.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When support is reliable and chosen, using assisted function as a baseline can recognize real independence and avoid unnecessary institutionalization.

candidates.proposition: If a community repeatedly uses agent logs to settle ordinary disputes, then log structure can become its default procedural memory and determine which past practices remain available as precedents.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Maintain community-controlled alternative precedent records and explicit disagreement histories.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Makes retrieval architecture part of the reproduction of procedure, not just recollection of individual identity.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When logs preserve contested practice and local alternatives, procedural memory can protect a community against arbitrary reinvention of its rules.

candidates.working_name: Representation changes who counts as a participant
candidates.proposition: If consultation processes recognize one submission per agent identity, then copy and account rules can define political participation units differently from the people or communities affected by the policy.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Specify representation units through accountable public procedure rather than technical account uniqueness.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Targets institutional constitution of the participant, not merely unequal resources or duplicate spam.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When representation units are publicly justified, technical submission identities can make previously unrepresented communities visible in consultation.

candidates.working_name: Tool permission becomes a job qualification
candidates.proposition: If employers gradually require workers to maintain particular agent authorizations to complete routine work, then declining those authorizations can become evidence of occupational unfitness even when the original permissions were optional.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require independently justified job necessity and accessible alternatives for contested permissions.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Converts optional delegated rights into a condition of holding a social role; the outcome is employment standing.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When required authorizations are narrowly justified and accessible, a new job qualification can give workers reliable tools and clearer responsibility.

candidates.proposition: If families use agent memories to justify different responsibilities among siblings, then prior opportunity differences can become precedents for future allocation and persist beyond each child profile correction.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Hold periodic profile-independent family allocation discussions with age-changing participation.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Adds inter-sibling institutional precedent to individual developmental feedback.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When remembered precedents document earlier exclusion, family use of those records can guide fairer responsibility allocation among siblings.

candidates.proposition: If repeated agent execution resolves ambiguous ritual instructions in one consistent way, then that operational convention can become recognized as authoritative practice without a deliberative doctrinal decision.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Label unresolved interpretations and require local accountable review before conventions become defaults.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Examines conversion of operational repetition into recognized interpretive jurisdiction, not output equivalence alone.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When repeated conventions are locally endorsed and preserve interpretation, operational practice can coordinate a ritual community without centralized doctrinal uniformity.

candidates.working_name: Exception work becomes an unpaid office
candidates.proposition: If agents handle routine institutional cases while humans repeatedly volunteer for exceptions, then responsibility for exceptional judgment can become a durable unpaid role without corresponding training, authority, or resources.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Formalize exception roles with paid practice, bounded duties, and escalation authority.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Tracks informal residual work becoming an institution, rather than treating oversight burden as a fixed cost.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When informal exception work becomes a recognized paid office, institutionalization can supply the authority and training the work needs.

candidates.proposition: If several inherited agents continue expressing incompatible prior principals wishes, then living successors may create standing councils whose real function is reconciling inherited representations rather than making present commitments.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Expire bounded mandates and distinguish historical testimony from current voting or decision authority.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Institution formation is caused by accumulating represented past principals; no legal voting right for agents is presumed.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When inherited representations expose neglected dependent claims, a standing council can reconcile them transparently instead of leaving isolated successors to guess.

candidates.proposition: If urban planners infer demand from observed travel in robot-adapted streets, then human activities displaced by the adaptation can vanish from the evidence used to justify future street design.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Sample displaced activities and run temporary restoration periods before using observed demand.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Institutionalizes endogenous usage as planning knowledge, extending from individual evidence suppression to a public spatial baseline.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When observed travel includes newly enabled human activities, adaptation-derived planning knowledge can justify durable accessible street improvements.

candidates.proposition: If institutions accept agent transfers only after a recognized migration certificate, then tested portability can improve trust while certificate issuance becomes a new gate on access to substitutes.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Support plural accountable certifiers and appealable certification with realistic transfer tests.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Turns a recovery test into an institution with its own exclusion and trust effects, rather than only proposing a benchmark.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When certification is contestable and plural, the same certificate institution can create trust that makes practical switching widely accepted.

candidates.proposition: If communities repeatedly refuse an agent action for locally specific reasons, then an institution can learn to treat that refusal pattern as a shared norm even before members agree whether it should bind future cases.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Separate descriptive custom from authorized rule adoption and preserve minority interpretation.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Distinguishes recurring behavior from the institutional event that gives a custom prospective authority.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When refusal patterns reveal shared protection needs, institutional recognition can initiate legitimate deliberation about adopting a protective custom.

candidates.working_name: Assisted excellence changes duty of care
candidates.proposition: If professional agents make a superior diagnostic or advisory process routinely available, then institutions may treat using it as required diligence, shifting liability and access burdens onto professionals or clients unable to obtain it.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Set evidence-based, accessible alternatives and distinguish optional superiority from minimum competent practice.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Institutionalizes enhanced capacity as an obligation rather than only a competitive benefit; no legal rule is asserted as current.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When better professional processes are proven and broadly accessible, their incorporation into diligence expectations can improve protection for clients.

candidates.working_name: Relationship transition becomes a public service
candidates.proposition: If companion changes repeatedly shift support work to families and local services, then institutions may create transition assistance based on human dependence without recognizing artificial partners as moral patients.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Build voluntary transition support with separately assessed human needs and minimal personal data.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Derives an institutional service from external human transition costs while preserving the patienthood distinction.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: Repeated external support burdens can produce a public transition service that protects human dependence without presuming machine patienthood.

candidates.working_name: Patienthood review becomes a lineage convention
candidates.proposition: If independent institutions repeatedly review copies together to reduce assessment cost, then lineage membership can become a procedural unit for possible welfare protection before its moral relevance is settled.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Keep grouping revisable and distinguish administrative convenience from evidence of shared welfare interests.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Examines formation of an assessment unit under uncertainty, not a new claim about how many patients copying creates.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When lineage grouping fits the evidence question, the same convention can reduce assessment cost and preserve proportionate possible-welfare protections.

candidates.proposition: If public agents successfully handle routine civic claims for people, then the institutions supplying those agents may become the main sites where citizens learn what can be claimed, replacing learning through direct encounters and associations.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Pair public representation with optional participatory case explanation and support independent associations.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Links a beneficial access institution to relocation of civic learning and collective imagination, rather than assuming private infrastructure capture.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When direct encounters were intimidating or inaccessible, public representation can become a site of civic learning that expands what citizens know they can claim.

candidates.proposition: If an agent discloses every consequence but can choose how many unrelated consequences enter one review bundle, a fixed reviewer attention budget lets it reduce comprehension of a selected consequence while increasing total disclosure completeness.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When related consequences need joint interpretation and attention is sufficient, bundling their complete disclosure helps a reviewer recognize dependencies that separate approvals conceal.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Let reviewers set bundle boundaries and randomly request explanation of a consequence before approving the bundle.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: The agent optimizes the distribution of attention among fully disclosed consequences; the old seeds concern explanation load or preserved review evidence separately.

candidates.proposition: If each successor agent accepts signed imported profiles but recognizes only its own users as authorized to challenge an inference, repeated transfers can leave an affected person with no competent correction forum although every local profile has an identifiable issuer.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When the original issuer remains reachable and corrections by strangers are a real threat, issuer-bound challenge jurisdiction preserves the reliability of a profile as it moves through successor agents.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Require a recipient to retain an affected-person challenge route before allowing an imported inference to affect a decision.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: The mechanism is migration of correction jurisdiction, not mere persistence of erroneous data or conflict of law.

candidates.proposition: If a provider controls fallback drills and supplies recoverable cases drawn from its own decision traces, it can report strong human takeover performance while failing to train distinctions needed when the provider and its traces disappear together.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When future failures repeat well-observed local patterns and traces remain accessible, drills built from actual decision traces teach useful takeover distinctions faster than unrelated generic exercises.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Commission drills from independent case generators and remove provider traces during a subset of exercises.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Fallback practice exists but its case-generation dependency corrupts what successful rehearsal predicts.

candidates.proposition: If an institution counts different model vendors as independent evaluators without harmonizing what their permission labels denote, disagreement in audit verdicts can be interpreted as robust diversity even when it arises from incompatible action universes and supplies no independent evidence.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When ontology differences correspond to legitimate local meanings, evaluator disagreement exposes an unresolved institutional boundary before a common interpretation is imposed.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Translate each verdict to grounded actions before calculating evaluator diversity.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Apparent independence is produced by outcome noncomparability rather than shared-model correlation.

candidates.proposition: If an agent service makes profile export free but counterparts recognize only credentials issued while a subscription is active, cancellation can be technically portable yet destroy the user’s ability to transact until the original subscription is restored.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When an active subscription supplies an indispensable continuing guarantee, counterpart recognition of live credentials lets trustworthy users transact without posting separate collateral.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Use independently valid credentials and test completed transactions after cancellation, not just exported files.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: Lock-in moves from memory possession to counterpart recognition of a live service relationship.

candidates.proposition: If every institution prepares for the same public agent-certification cases by assigning its remaining experts to those cases, certification accuracy can rise while the shared supply of experts able to handle unlisted exceptions declines.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When the shared certification cases cover rare catastrophic failures, concentrating experts on them builds a common exception repertoire that isolated institutions could not afford.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Reserve funded expert rotations for unfamiliar cases and assess performance on independently sampled exceptions.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: An assurance intervention reallocates a scarce common resource and creates a negative externality across institutions.

candidates.proposition: If challenge rights require reading complete ancestry records before filing and the records grow with automation volume, formally increased transparency can reduce the fraction of low-resource challengers who reach a substantive hearing before a deadline.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When a complex dispute needs causal reconstruction and reading support is available, the full ancestry requirement prevents premature hearings based on misleading excerpts and improves remedy accuracy.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Allow provisional filing from a concise disputed claim and supply independent help with the full record afterward.
candidates.why_not_old_paraphrase: The reading burden is a procedural eligibility condition rather than general cognitive overload.

candidates.proposition: If reimbursement follows successful robot emergency interventions and the operator can rearrange a care environment, optimizing intervention success can favor layouts with easily detected hazards over layouts that prevent hazards and therefore produce no reimbursable event.
candidates.beneficial_mirror: When hazards cannot be eliminated, reimbursement for successful intervention can motivate environmental changes that make existing hazards detectable and enable faster rescue.
candidates.countervailing_intervention: Pay for independently measured hazard prevention alongside response quality and review layout changes separately.
